name: Matrix
description: All-in-one Matrix homeserver for Unraid: Synapse + coturn + Element Web (/element/) + Synapse-Admin (/admin/). Plug-and-play — just fill in SERVER_NAME and Postgres connection, everything else is generated automatically. PREREQUISITES (before starting the container): 1) PostgreSQL database — connect to your Postgres container and run: CREATE USER matrix WITH PASSWORD 'yourpass'; CREATE DATABASE matrix ENCODING 'UTF8' LC_COLLATE='C' LC_CTYPE='C' TEMPLATE template0 OWNER matrix; (UTF8 + LC_COLLATE='C' is mandatory — Synapse will refuse to start otherwise.) 2) Reverse proxy (Nginx Proxy Manager) for matrix.yourdomain.tld → Unraid-IP:8008. In the proxy host → Advanced tab, add: client_max_body_size 100m; proxy_read_timeout 600s; (Without these, media uploads fail and long-running requests time out.) 3) Federation discovery works out of the box: Synapse serves /.well-known/matrix/server and /.well-known/matrix/client itself on the API port (8008), so the proxy host from step 2 already covers them. No extra Custom Locations needed (remove any manual ones from older setups). Full step-by-step guide (NPM screenshots, well-known, first user): https://github.com/junkerderprovinz/matrix#readme

paths.name: Data Directory
paths.description: Persistent data: homeserver.yaml, media, signing keys. Never delete — destroys keys and breaks federation.

paths.name: TURN-TLS Certs
paths.description: Optional. Mount a folder containing fullchain.pem + privkey.pem to enable TURN-TLS on 5349.

ports.name: Matrix HTTP API
ports.description: Synapse HTTP API. Expose via reverse proxy with HTTPS — never directly to the internet.

ports.name: Element Web + Synapse-Admin
ports.description: Serves Element Web (/element/), Synapse-Admin (/admin/) and /.well-known/matrix/* endpoints.

ports.name: TURN TCP
ports.description: TURN/STUN over TCP for voice/video calls. Open this port in your router/firewall.

ports.name: TURN UDP
ports.description: TURN/STUN over UDP for voice/video calls. Open this port in your router/firewall.

ports.name: TURN TLS TCP
ports.description: TURN over TLS (TCP). Optional — only if TLS certs are mounted.

ports.name: TURN TLS UDP
ports.description: TURN over TLS (UDP). Optional — only if TLS certs are mounted.

ports.name: TURN relay ports (UDP)
ports.description: UDP relay port range for TURN (voice/video calls). Must match the container's coturn min-port/max-port.

ports.name: Prometheus Metrics
ports.description: Prometheus metrics at /_synapse/metrics. Bind to a private network only.

variables.name: Matrix Server Domain
variables.description: Your Matrix domain, e.g. matrix.yourdomain.tld. Used in Matrix IDs (@user:matrix.yourdomain.tld). Cannot be changed later without wiping the DB.

variables.name: Anonymous Usage Reporting
variables.description: Send anonymous usage stats to Matrix.org. 'yes' or 'no'. Recommended: no.

variables.name: Enable Federation
variables.description: true = chat with the public Matrix network. The container now serves /.well-known/matrix/* itself (serve_server_wellknown) as long as https://SERVER_NAME/ is routed to Synapse — no extra proxy rule needed. false = private island.

variables.name: Enable Registration
variables.description: false = accounts created by the admin only (recommended). true = open self-service signup WITHOUT verification (shows Element's Create Account button) — only enable behind a CAPTCHA or on a trusted network, or you will get spam signups.

variables.name: TURN Domain
variables.description: Optional. Public hostname clients reach TURN (voice/video) at. Leave empty to use SERVER_NAME; set a dedicated subdomain (e.g. turn.yourdomain.tld) to route TURN around a reverse proxy.

variables.name: TURN Port
variables.description: Optional. Public TURN port advertised to clients (default 3478). Change only if you remapped the published TURN port.

variables.name: PostgreSQL Host
variables.description: IP of your PostgreSQL server (e.g. Unraid host IP). 192.168.1.10 is a placeholder — replace it with your server's IP. IP+port is more reliable than container names.

variables.name: PostgreSQL Username
variables.description: Postgres user for Synapse. Must already exist (see README — Postgres setup).

variables.name: PostgreSQL Password
variables.description: Password for the Postgres user above.

variables.name: PostgreSQL Database
variables.description: Synapse database name. Must be created with ENCODING UTF8, LC_COLLATE='C', LC_CTYPE='C' — see Overview.

variables.name: Matrix Admin Username (Element / Synapse-Admin login)
variables.description: Optional. Localpart of the admin user to auto-create on first boot (e.g. 'admin' → @admin:SERVER_NAME). Logs into Element Web + Synapse-Admin. Clear after creation.

variables.name: Matrix Admin Password (Element / Synapse-Admin login)
variables.description: Optional. Password for the admin user above. Clear after first boot.

variables.name: User ID (PUID)
variables.description: UID Synapse runs as. Default 99 (nobody on Unraid).

variables.name: Group ID (PGID)
variables.description: GID Synapse runs as. Default 100 (users on Unraid).
